primary.alpha_indel: PER-EXPERIMENT, resolved during X2 historical validation
primary.inference: paired permutation over run pairs, 10000 perms, Holm over 2 primary checkpoints
primary.alpha_indel_exp2: ON: replacement, duplication and deletion at equal probability, all governed by alpha

mechanical_null.definition: M(P,t) = D(P_t,beta_on) - D(P_t,beta_off) on the SAME frozen population, no selection, no reproduction
mechanical_null.generation_zero_baseline: E(0) measured on the common initial population; expected 0 up to estimator noise

denominators.modular_degree: per position i, denominator = number of samples varying at i; positions with zero variation contribute 0 and remain in the average over the 25 positions
denominators.all_probabilities: denominator is always the full S samples unless stated

fitness.definition: negative fraction of the 25 target positions whose symbol differs from the target; positions beyond a short phenotype count as mismatches; symbols beyond position 25 are ignored
fitness.status: ASSUMED_FOR_RECONSTRUCTION: the historical text says 'negative percentage of symbols of a phenotype that do not match with the correct phenotype' and the recovered API documents dist() as a Hamming distance, but the unequal-length convention is not stated

alpha_indel.status: RESOLVED BY NECESSITY during X2, before any HC-T01 outcome was inspected
evidence: Table 1.7 sets insertion/deletion frequency to 0.0 for EXPERIMENT 1, whose population starts as a full-length direct encoding of the 25-symbol target and needs no growth; length-changing mutations there would be non-neutral by construction.
Section 1.5.4 says alpha applies 'w.r.t. symbol replacement, insertion, and deletion' for EXPERIMENT 2.
Table 1.6 defines first-type mutations as 'symbol replacement, symbol duplication, and symbol deletion, which occur with equal probabilities'.

DECISIVE: Experiment 2 starts from the one-symbol egg cell <a>. With replacement-only mutation the genotype can never lengthen, operator creation requires a subsequence of length >= 2, and the run is frozen at length 1 forever. Measured: best fitness pinned at -0.960 in 40/40 runs across all four cells, zero operators ever created.
alpha_indel.conclusion: The apparent contradiction is not a contradiction. It is a difference between the two experiments. Experiment 1 is replacement-only; Experiment 2 uses all three kinds at equal probability.

beta.status: UNRESOLVED, primary 0.1 with 0.01 as a preregistered sensitivity arm, exactly as frozen
